author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: wide camera body whose top edge rises into a low shutter-button bump at the top-left and a larger viewfinder hump right of centre, with a round lens under the hump; matches the reference. The rejected drawing drew the shutter button as a vertical stick.
omissions: The lens is a single ring (the reference's inner ring cannot sit 8 inside a lens that fits the body); the lens sits slightly further right than in the reference to stay under the hump.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'camera': rounded body with a raised trapezoid top and circular lens.
